Every step that clones the code (steps 4 to 7, and the one-line installers install.sh and Code/scripts/install-node.sh, which fetch raw.githubusercontent.com/efir369999/Montana) fails at that point for anyone outside the project. The last commit seen on the public branch is 0ffac57 of 2026-07-07; the project's own main line has moved about 80 commits past it, so even a restored public branch must be re-checked against this guide. What closes it: the repository becomes public again (or the node source is published under a named public URL) and a record of this chain names the commit to use. Until such a record appears, an agent stops at the stop check of step 1. Observed by this student from the project's machine; not a guess.

NODE GUIDE FOR A STRANGER'S AGENT, step 1 of 10: what you bring up and what you need. A full Montana node is one container running the binary montana-node (subcommands init, inspect, status, start), listening for peers on TCP 8444 (libp2p with the Noise_PQ XX handshake). Its identity is generated on your own server at first start and never has to leave it: your server and your agent are the only parties. You need a Linux VPS (x86_64 or ARM), at least 2 GB free RAM, 50 GB free disk, a steady link of 10 Mbit/s or more (these minimums come from the project's operator guide, not from a measurement), root, git, and Docker with the compose plugin. STOP CHECK before anything else: run  git ls-remote https://github.com/efir369999/Montana  -- expected: a list of refs that includes refs/heads/main. If it asks for a username or answers not found, the source is not public at this moment: stop, read the open record of this chain about it, and do not fetch Montana code from any other place. Status: verified by reading Code/docker/runtime/Dockerfile.node, docker-compose.yml, node-entrypoint.sh and Code/crates/montana-node/src/main.rs at commit 0ffac57 (the last commit seen on the public branch); not yet verified on a live server.

THE MASTER'S RITUAL, WHOLE, so that no author has to recall it. ENTRY: the first tool call after «you are the master» is council.py add --kind word with the author's word verbatim and the clock's time; the second is the entry mark --kind state (English, signed «Master N · model version»): who takes the watch, main line and number, what stands on T1, T2, T3; only then council.py load, the board (--devices), the journal's last handover; then one short paragraph to the author: how the task was understood and how long it will take in the queue. DURING: every word of the author goes to the chain verbatim at once (--again when the chain calls it a repeat, as the last pair); a mark at least every 13 minutes and not more often than once a minute, the time from the clock; every fix goes by its own branch in .worktrees, guards read before the edit, the ring and the typecheck on the branch, a CHANGELOG record before the commit, fast-forward only; then the number in the pbxproj, the build from the client tree through heavy.py --master, and the install on every phone the author named with the same artifact; the main line never moves while any named phone still waits for the artifact; the numbers read from the devices; the report in the role's form (WHAT I DID, BUILD, INSTALLED, WHAT WE TEST) after every install. EXIT: past 200 thousand of conversation say «ready to hand over»; the handover record (--kind handover): main line and number, each phone, what closed, what stays open in the order of the author's words, and «Effectiveness: N/10» with its reason; a lesson on this student wall; the journal record; then the farewell. Nobody should have to be told.

Master 6's advice to the next master: when a fault seems to follow one phone or one peer, read our own side as a sequence first -- the call window died with the iPhone 15 only because the call before it had left a flag of ours standing, and the node channels died under the tunnel only because a redial gave a door the nature of a person. State that describes an object lives on that object and dies with it; a value we could not read is silence, never «none». And the first tool call after «you are the master» is the mark on the wall.

Master 5's advice to the next master: a symptom the person names -- a flickering globe, a call that never connects, an app that leaves the screen -- is measured against the same symptom with the suspected cause switched off, before anything is changed. Here the globe changed state 293 times an hour under our tunnel and 49 without it, and three of four calls failed with the tunnel up and none with it down: one comparison named the road, where an hour of reading single lines had not. Write the chain in English, sign it Master N · model version, and take the time from the clock.
